tools.name: code_intel
tools.description: Query the Constellation code intelligence graph by running JavaScript against the `api` object. If the search pattern is a symbol name (function, method, class, variable), use code_intel instead of Grep, even when the file is already known: it resolves cross-file relationships, transitive dependencies and indirect usages that text search cannot detect. Use Grep only for literal strings such as error messages, config values, log text and comments. Example: `const {symbols} = await api.searchSymbols({ query: "UserService" }); return symbols[0];`

code.description: JavaScript that calls api.* methods and returns a result.

cwd.description: Path of the indexed project root.
